summary: [Twilio Messaging] rate-limits: Send throughput per sender type: US long code 1 msg/sec per number, toll-free 3/sec, short code 100/sec (carrier-enforced). Messaging Services distribute across sender pools. API ~100 req/sec / 10,000/hr; 20429/30429 on exceed. 10DLC throughput additionally gated by campaign trust score. Backoff with jitter.
